description: prompt-cut: registers /prompt-cut (session.start), hidden from the typeahead (command.describe), which a key bound to command:prompt-cut runs; the cut reads the box ($.prompt.read), expands each paste placeholder from the mod's records ($.state) or a recalled prompt's history entry (history.jsonl and paste-cache via $.process.run and $.fs.read), copies the text ($.ui.copy) and empties the box ($.prompt.fill), answering with no text so no transcript row is left (command.run); with a paste whose text is unknown it writes the draft over itself (prompt mode) and arms Enter, shown as [Enter cuts ✕] on the hint row (ui.render on PromptHint, ui.press), and the armed Enter's prompt.submit, which carries every paste expanded, is copied and dropped, the restored draft emptied again (prompt.submit); reads the clipboard right after each paste the engine turns into a placeholder (prompt.change with origin engine, prompt.edit, $.process.run), marks placeholders typed or filled in as text plain text (prompt.edit, prompt.fill, prompt.change), and rebuilds a truncation of a long draft from the draft before it (prompt.change, prompt.fill).
